tasks.prompt: You recently visited a new restaurant in town with your family, and you were very impressed with the food and service. You want to share your positive experience with the restaurant manager, Ms. Garcia, and make a suggestion for a new menu item.
bullets: ●  Describe what you enjoyed about your visit.
●  Suggest one new menu item and briefly describe it.
●  Explain why you think the new menu item would be a good addition.
tasks.subject: Feedback and menu suggestion

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
   ●  Express and support your opinion.
   ●  Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: We’ve been discussing the effects of different leadership styles on businesses. Some argue that authoritarian leadership, where a boss makes decisions with little input from their workers, is effective because it provides clear direction and expectations. Others believe that democratic leadership is better as it encourages employee participation and morale. Which leadership style do you think is more effective? Why?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I think authoritarian leadership is more effective. It ensures that everyone knows their roles and responsibilities, which can increase productivity because workers are given clear directions for the job at hand. In high-pressure situations, clear direction can prevent confusion and mistakes.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I prefer democratic leadership. It values employees’ input and can lead to more creative solutions and higher job satisfaction. When employees feel heard and valued, they are more motivated and committed to their work.
